reason: The plugin provides an artifact tool for creating and incrementally patching HTML documents with live interactive GUI previews and optional submission of artifact interaction data.

summaries.zh: 通过 artifact 工具创建、增量修补和管理 HTML 文档，并在 GUI 中实时显示可交互预览。
summaries.en: Creates, incrementally patches, and manages HTML documents through an artifact tool with live interactive previews in the GUI.

capabilities: creates, patches, reads, lists, and destroys HTML artifacts
renders HTML live in an iframe-based preview
executes artifact-provided inline scripts in the preview
collects submitted artifact state, form values, and button interactions into the current session
allows HTML previews to reference external HTTP or HTTPS resources
